title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
heading: SCOPE
text:
SCOPE

This standard prescribes the requirements and
methods of sampling and test for packaged drinking
water (other than natural mineral water) offered for
consumption and/or for sale in packaged form.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
heading: REFERENCES
text:
REFERENCES

The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions
which through reference in this text, constitute
provisions of this standard. At the time of
publication, the editions indicated were valid. All
standards are subject to revision and parties to
agreements based on this standard are encouraged to
investigate the possibility of applying the most
recent edition of these standards.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
heading: TERMINOLOGY
text:
TERMINOLOGY

For the purpose of this standard, the following terms
shall apply.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Drinking Water (Other than Natural Mineral
Water) — Means water from any potable water
source including public drinking water supply
systems (see IS 10500).

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Packaged Drinking Water (Other than
Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Means
water, other than natural mineral water that is likely
to be used for human consumption and that is
offered or sold in packaged form, by whatever name
it may be called, offered or sold.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
heading: HYGIENIC CONDITIONS
text:
HYGIENIC CONDITIONS

Source water shall be collected, processed, handled,
packaged and marketed in accordance with the
hygienic practices given in Annex B. A check list
for good hygienic practices and food safety system
for packaged water processing units is given in
Annex C.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: REQUIREMENTS

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
General Requirements
civic water supply or underground water or sea
water or any other consistent source of water which
may be subjected to herein under specified
treatments,
namely,
decantation,
distillation,
filtration, combination of filtration, aerations,
filtration with membrane filter, depth filter,
cartridge
filter,
activated
carbon
filtration,
demineralization, remineralization, reverse osmosis
and packed after disinfecting the water to a level
that shall not lead to any harmful effect in the
drinking water by means of chemical agents or
physical methods to reduce the number of micro-
organisms to a level below scientifically accepted
level for food safety or its suitability: Provided that
sea water, before being subjected to the above
treatments, shall be subjected to desalination and
related processes.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text: Water shall be derived from surface water or

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
It shall be filled in sealed containers of various
compositions, forms and capacities that are suitable
for direct consumption without further treatment. In
case remineralization is a part of the treatment
process, the ingredients used shall conform to food
grade/pharma grade quality.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Microbiological Requirements
Packaged drinking water shall comply with
the requirements given in 5.2.1 to 5.2.9.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Escherichia coli — (or thermotolerant
bacteria) shall be absent in any 250 ml sample
when tested in accordance with the method given in
IS 15185.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Coliform — bacteria shall be absent in any
250 ml sample when tested in accordance with the
method given in IS 5401 (Part 1) or IS 15185*.
NOTE — In case of dispute, the method indicated by '*'
shall be the reference method.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Faecal Streptococci and Staphylococcus
aureus — shall be absent in any 250 ml sample
when tested in accordance with the method given in
IS 5887 (Part 2). Faecal Streptococci (Enterococci)
may also be tested by the method specified in
IS 15186*.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Sulphite Reducing Anaerobes — shall be
absent in 50 ml sample when tested in accordance
with the method given in Annex C of IS 13428.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Pseudomonas Aeruginosa — shall be absent
in 250 ml sample when tested in accordance with
the method given in Annex D of IS 13428* or
ISO 16266-2.
NOTE — In case of dispute, the method indicated by ‘*’
shall be the referee method

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Aerobic Microbial Count
The total viable colony count shall not exceed
100/ml at 20 °C to 22 °C in 72 h and 20/ml at
37 °C ± 1 °C in 24 h when tested in accordance
with the methods given in IS 5402 (Part 1).

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Yeast and mould shall be absent in 250 ml
sample when tested in accordance with the method
given in IS 16069 (Part 1) (see Note under 5.2.9) .

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Salmonella and Shigella — shall be absent in
250 ml sample when tested in accordance with the
method given in IS 15187 and IS 5887 (Part 7)
(see Note under 5.2.9), respectively.
NOTE — The membrane filtration technique outlined in
IS 15188 may be used to pass the sample of water to be
tested through membrane before the microbiological tests
specified from 5.2.1 to 5.2.3, 5.2.5 and 5.2.7 to 5.2.9 are
carried out.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Vibrio cholera and V. parahaemolyticus —
shall be absent in 250 ml sample when tested in
accordance
with
the
method
given
in
[IS 5887 (Part 5/Sec 1) (see Note)].

text:
Packaged drinking water shall be clear without
any sediments, suspended particles and extraneous
matter. It shall also comply with the requirements
given in Table 1, Table 2, Table 3 and 4.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
heading: PACKING
text: PACKING

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
It shall be packed in clean, hygienic and
tamperproof containers/bottles/pouches made of
food grade plastic material or other food grade
packaging materials, namely paper and paper board
materials; glass (see IS 11984); and metal and metal
alloys which may or may not contain plastic as
component, compatible with the water to be
packaged.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Plastic containers shall conform to IS 15410
and polyethylene flexible pouches shall conform to
IS 15609. Guidelines for handling of polyethylene
flexible pouches are given in Annex E.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Paper based multilayer laminated/extruded
composite cartons shall conform to IS 17753 and
aluminium cans shall conform to IS 18285.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
All packaging materials of plastic origin shall
pass the overall migration, colour migration and
specific migration limits for toxic substances as laid
down in IS 15410.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
heading: MARKING
text: MARKING

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
The following particulars shall be marked
legibly and indelibly on the label of the
bottle/container:
a) Name of the product in capital letters (that
is, packaged drinking water);
b) Name and address of the processor;
c) Brand name, if any;
d) Batch or code number;
e) Date of manufacture or packaging and
‘Expiry/use by;
f) Treatment of disinfection, if any;
g) Best before date (optional);
h) Net quantity;
j) Direction for storage;
k) Keep away from direct sunlight; and
m) Any other information required under the
Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities)
Rules, 2011 and the Food Safety and
Standards
(Labelling
and
Display)
Regulations, 2020.
NOTE — The manner of declaration of date of
manufacture or packaging/Expiry/Use by/Best before,
shall follow the DD/MM/YY format for products with
shelf life upto three months. For products with shelf life
more than three months, either DD/MM/YY format shall
be used or the month and the year shall be declared in un-
coded numerical sequence except that the month shall be
indicated by capital letters and abbreviations (at least first
three letters of the month) may be used.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
Labelling Prohibitions
7.2.1
No
claims
concerning
medicinal
(Preventative, alleviative or curative) effects shall
be made in respect of the properties of the product
covered by this standard. Claims of other beneficial
effects related to the health of the consumer shall
not be made.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
The name of the locality, hamlet or specified
place may not form part of the brand name unless it
refers to a packaged drinking water collected
processed at the place designated by that brand
name.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
text:
The use of any statement or of any pictorial
device which may create confusion in the mind of
the public or in any way mislead the public about
the nature origin, composition and properties of
drinking water is prohibited.

F-1.2.3.1 The bottles/pouches shall be chosen at
random from the lot. In order to ensure the
randomness of selection, procedure given in IS 4905
shall be followed.
F-1.2.4 Initially the number of cartons/bags equal to
the number of bottles/pouches to be taken from the
lot [according to col (3) of Table 5], shall be chosen
at random. These cartons/bags thus selected shall be
opened and the bottles/ pouches in these
cartons/bags examined visually for the condition of
packing, external appearance and the fill. The lot
shall be considered satisfactory for inspection of
other characteristics given in the standard, if all the
bottles/pouches in the cartons/bags opened are
found satisfactory for these characteristics.
F-1.2.5 In case any defective bottle/pouch is found
according to F-1.2.4, twice the number of cartons/
bags shall be opened and the bottles/pouches
examined for these characteristics. If no defective
bottle is found; the lot shall be considered
satisfactory for inspection of other characteristic
given in the specification.
F-1.3 Preparation of Test Samples
F-1.3.1 From each of the cartons/bags opened
according to F-1.2.4, three bottles/pouches shall be
taken from its different layers so as to obtain three
times the required number of bottles/pouches/
pouches in the sample [see col (3) of Table 5].
F-1.3.2 In case the number of cartons/bags to be
opened is according to F-1.2.4, the number of
cartons/bags equal to the number of bottles/pouches
in the sample shall be taken at random from these
cartons/bags and then the required number of

title: Dimethyl Ether (DME) Blended Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) — Specification
text:
This standard prescribes the requirements and
methods of sampling and test for Dimethyl Ether
(DME) blended Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG)
marked for distribution and usage in household,
commercial and industrial applications excluding
automotive use in the country.

title: Dimethyl Ether (DME) Blended Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) — Specification
text:
This standard does not purport to address all of
the safety problems associated with its use. It is the
responsibility of the user of this standard to establish
appropriate safety and health practices and
determine the applicability of regulatory limitations
prior to use.

heading: TERMINOLOGY
text:
TERMINOLOGY

For the purpose of this standard, the following
definitions shall apply.

title: Dimethyl Ether (DME) Blended Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) — Specification
text:
Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LP Gas or LPG) —
See IS 4639 (Part 1).

title: Dimethyl Ether (DME) Blended Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) — Specification
text:
LP gases mainly consist of one or more of the
following hydrocarbons:
a)
Propane (C3H8);
b)
Propylene (C3H6);
c)
n-butane (C4H10);
d)
ISO-butane (C4H10); and
e)
Butylene (C4H8).

title: Dimethyl Ether (DME) Blended Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) — Specification
text:
Small quantities of one or more of the
following hydrocarbons may also be present:
a)
Ethane (C2H6);
b)
Ethylene (C2H4);
c)
Pentane (C5H12); and
c)
Pentene (C5H10).

title: Dimethyl Ether (DME) Blended Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) — Specification
text:
Di Methyl Ether (DME) — Colorless gas
containing Oxygen, synthetically produced from
gasification of biomass or coal, methanol, Syn gas
or natural gas, capable of being used as alternate
fuel.

title: Dimethyl Ether (DME) Blended Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) — Specification
text:
DME LPG Blend — Blend of LPG and DME
as per specified ratio. This blend contains Oxygen
molecule.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
heading: SCOPE
text:
SCOPE

This standard specifies the age-rating labels and
content descriptors based on the content of video
games and digital games that are published and
distributed publicly.

investigate the possibility of applying the most

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
heading: TERMS AND DEFINITIONS
text:
TERMS AND DEFINITIONS

For the purposes of this standard, the definitions
given in IS 19226 and the following shall apply:

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
Age-Rating Mark — A classification assigned
to video or digital games that indicates the suitability
of the content for specific age groups based on the
presence of elements such as violence, language,
sexual content, or other mature themes.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
Content Descriptor — Terms that accompany
and aid an age-rating mark under this standard in
providing specific information about the type of
content that led to the age-rating classification,
which assists consumer in making informed
decisions.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Label —
Display of age-rating classification and content
description categories as specified under this
standard for video or digital games.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
heading: AGE-RATING MARK CATEGORIES
text: AGE-RATING MARK CATEGORIES

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
heading: CONTENT DESCRIPTORS CATEGORIES
text:
CONTENT DESCRIPTORS CATEGORIES

Video or digital games published, or distributed,
shall carry the appropriate content descriptors in
lowercase letters separated by commas, which may
be self-assessed according to content within the
game as provided in Table 2, except under the
condition of limited display-size, as specified under

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
heading: LABELING AND CONSUMER INFORMATION
text: LABELING AND CONSUMER INFORMATION

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text: Legibility of Label

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
The age-rating and content descriptor label on
video games, or their marketing material, applicable
to games made available through physical or digital
storefronts, shall be clearly and legibly displayed to
ensure easy visibility and understanding.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
The age-rating and content descriptor label
shall be displayed on the game box art, digital game
or app storefronts, television advertisement, digital
advertisements, and physical advertisements of the
relevant game.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
The text, symbols, and background contrast
shall be designed to meet the appropriate legibility
requirements, enabling clear reading under normal
usage conditions.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text: Label Size, Proportions and Placement

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
The age-rating label shall be placed at a
prominent location on the primary display panel or
the initial viewing screen of the digital storefront for
the relevant game.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
The outer boundary of the label shall be a
square bisected into two equal halves by a single
horizontal line. The dimensions of the label shall
conform to requirements mentioned in Fig. 1.
Video or digital games published, or distributed,
shall carry the appropriate Age-Rating Mark, in
uppercase letters, which may be self-assessed, as
provided in Table 1, except in cases of limited
display size, as specified under 6.2.5 where a
modified label may be applicable.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
The total length of the label shall equal the total
width of the label. The length of the upper and lower
compartments of the label shall also be equal to each
other.

title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification
text:
The text constituting the age-rating mark shall
be centrally placed in the upper compartment of the
label, whereas the text constituting the content
descriptor shall be placed within the lower
compartment in accordance with the legibility
standards.
